dict.string: Axial Memory looks for Grasshopper files on your Desktop. It only reads them: nothing is changed, moved or uploaded.
Axial Memory looks for Grasshopper files in Documents. It only reads them: nothing is changed, moved or uploaded.
Axial Memory looks for Grasshopper files in Downloads. It only reads them: nothing is changed, moved or uploaded.
Axial Memory looks for Grasshopper files on connected drives. It only reads them: nothing is changed, moved or uploaded.
Axial Memory looks for Grasshopper files on network drives you turn on. It only reads them.
Axial Memory checks the names of files in iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive and Google Drive. It doesn't download them.
